Since the [[League of Ireland 2008|2008]] season they have played at the [[UCD Bowl]], also home to the [[University College Dublin R.F.C.|college's rugby team]]. 'The Students' play in bright sky blue and navy. Their reserve and freshers teams play in the [[Leinster Senior League (association football)|Leinster Senior League]].
